changeSet.author: nexus-alsq3
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans_floored gains a trailing p_quarantine_expires_at text DEFAULT NULL (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, else invalid_parameter_value): after the move it writes metadata quarantine_expires_at on the rows that call moved and that carry no stamp yet. NULL writes nothing. The ten-argument signature is dropped and the eleven-argument one is granted to nexus_svc. The base move functions are unchanged.

changeSet.author: nexus-alsq3
changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_expire_client_quarantine expires a client-moved row at the later of the engine's retention (p_cutoff against quarantined_at) and the row's own metadata quarantine_expires_at (against now()); a row without the stamp keeps the engine's retention alone, and a stamp that is present but malformed is ignored (the engine's retention alone). Same signature and grants; the rest of the body is vectors-028-1.
